about: recap_chapter (chapters.py) and recapChapter (js/chapters.js): the map chapter a chapter recap sits in. `map` and `words` name entries of `maps` and `blockWords` (null: no word counts); `expected` is the chapter's start, or null. `tidy`: absent is the identity, "lower" lowercases (both ports compare titles case-insensitively anyway).
